patients.summary: Thirty-something high school shop teacher who also stocks part time at a medical-supply warehouse, with childhood-onset mild persistent asthma managed on albuterol alone. Worsening control in 2023 brings a pulmonology visit after a PFT showing reversible obstruction; influenza A in March 2025 and an employer-mandated occupational health session that fall. Otherwise routine primary care.

documents.title: New Patient Intake Call
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Caller is a 31 y/o male looking to establish care. Moved his care from his previous primary care office (last seen there a while ago, he isn't sure exactly when). Membership agreement and welcome packet emailed. Records release signed electronically and faxed to prior office today. Insurance: BCBS PPO, card photo uploaded. Booked new patient physical 8/20 at 8:40. Asked him to bring his inhaler and any vaccine records he has.

documents.title: New Patient Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
NEW PATIENT / ESTABLISH CARE

31M here to set up with us. Was at another primary care office for years, drifted away from it. No acute concerns today.

Asthma since he was a kid, probably around age 6 or 7. Only ever used a rescue inhaler. Uses albuterol a few times a week, mostly when he exercises or when it's cold out. No ED visits or steroid bursts he can recall as an adult. No nighttime symptoms currently.

PMH: asthma as above. No surgeries.
Meds: albuterol HFA 90 mcg, 2 puffs q4-6h prn.
Allergies: no drug allergies. Environmental: dust mites, seasonal pollen.
FH: mother has asthma. Father has hay fever and high blood pressure.
SH: teaches shop at the high school. Also works part time stocking at a medical-supply warehouse on weekends and some evenings. Never smoked. Drinks socially, 1-2 a week. Single, lives in Northampton.

ROS: negative except as above.

Exam: Well appearing, comfortable. HEENT unremarkable, TMs clear, oropharynx clear. Neck supple, no adenopathy. Lungs clear bilaterally, good air movement, no wheeze. Heart RRR, no murmur. Abdomen soft, nontender. Extremities without edema. Skin no rash.

PHQ-2: 0.

A/P
1. Mild persistent asthma, childhood onset. Using albuterol a few times a week with exertion/cold. Lungs clear today. Continue albuterol as needed. Reviewed technique with him, he's fine.
2. Health maintenance: CBC, CMP, lipids. One-time HIV and hep C screening, he agreed. Requested prior records for vaccine history. Flu shot this fall.

RTC 1 year or sooner prn.

documents.title: Lab Results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Hi Chad, your blood work from Thursday came back fine. Blood counts, kidney and liver tests, and cholesterol are all fine for now. HIV and hepatitis C screens are negative. Nothing more to do on these. Good to meet you last week.

documents.title: Records From Prior Primary Care Office
documents.author: MA
documents.body:
Received by fax, 14 pages, from patient's prior primary care office. Scanned to media.

Abstracted:
- Problem list: asthma.
- Medications: albuterol inhaler prn, refilled periodically.
- Immunizations: Tdap 05/06/2014. No other adult vaccines listed.
- Last office visit on file 2018, physical, unremarkable.

Routed to PCP.

documents.title: Immunization
documents.author: RN
documents.body: In after school for flu vaccine. Screening questions negative, no egg or vaccine reactions. Quadrivalent flu 0.5 mL IM left deltoid. VIS given. Tolerated well, left after brief wait.

documents.title: Covid vaccine card
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Got both Pfizer shots through the clinic they ran for school staff. 3/12 and 4/2. Picture of the card attached. Second one wiped me out for about a day but I'm fine now.

documents.title: RE: Covid vaccine card
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Thanks Chad, both doses are entered in your record now.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Annual

Feeling good. Summer off from school, picked up extra warehouse shifts. Asthma about the same as last year, albuterol a few times a week with workouts or cold mornings. Needs a refill. No ED/urgent care visits this year.

Meds: albuterol prn. Allergies: NKDA; dust mites, pollen.
SH unchanged, never smoker.

Exam: NAD. HEENT normal. Neck supple. Lungs clear, no wheeze. Heart regular, no murmur. Abd benign. No edema. Skin clear.
PHQ-2 0.

A/P
- Asthma: stable on rescue inhaler alone. Refill sent.
- Covid vaccine series done in spring.
- Labs last year fine, none needed today.
- Flu shot in the fall.

See him next year.

documents.title: Flu Vaccine
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Flu vaccine given, 0.5 mL IM R deltoid, lot recorded. Denies fever or illness today. Pt plans to get Covid booster at pharmacy next month.

documents.title: Booster
documents.author: patient
documents.body: FYI got the booster at the pharmacy on 11/19. Pfizer again.

documents.title: RE: Booster
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Added to your immunization record, thank you!
